answer_1.quote: To form it, we use LLMs (GPT-3), prompting them to create user summaries, as they have historically done well on this task.
datasets: Collected Twitter datasets for BLM and Abortion/Feminism events
answer_1.outputs: User summaries capturing their perspectives based on profiles and tweets

answer_3.quote: we feed all user summaries to a dialogue LLM, Chat-GPT, asking it: Which users have the same perspective?

answer_4.quote: humans read the summaries, analyzing user perspective towards the entity.
answer_4.guideline: We say users have the same perspective if they discuss the same entity in a similar way
